measures.title: Regular Property Tax Levy Lid Lift for Library Services, Operations and Maintenance
measures.what_it_does: Restores the library district's regular property tax levy from about $0.22 to $0.35 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 and 2028; the 2028 amount becomes the base for later levy limits.
measures.cost_line: $0.35 per $1,000 of assessed value (about $40 a year more on a $334,000 home, per the explanatory statement).

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Levy to Maintain Essential Services, Public Safety and Emergency Services, Operations and Capital Improvements
measures.what_it_does: Lifts Montesano's regular property tax levy to a total rate of up to $3.22 per $1,000 from 2027, with up to 5% yearly increases for six years, to keep current General Fund and public safety and emergency service levels.
measures.cost_line: Total city regular levy up to $3.22 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Bonds to Improve Safety, Security and School Facilities
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes $12,800,000 of general obligation bonds, maturing within 21 years and repaid by excess property taxes, for a secure entry vestibule, locks and keycard access, fire alarm, HVAC, exterior, drainage, parking and playground work at McCleary School.
measures.cost_line: $12,800,000 in bonds repaid by an excess property tax levy over up to 21 years.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Grays Harbor County Fire Protection District No. 1
measures.title: Emergency Medical Services Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a permanent regular property tax levy for emergency medical services.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value, permanent.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Grays Harbor County Fire Protection District No. 2
measures.title: Two Year Levy Lid Lift
measures.what_it_does: Restores the fire district's regular property tax levy to $1.50 per $1,000 (from about $1.40 in 2026) for 2026 and 2027 levies; the 2027 amount becomes the base for later levy limits.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
